Nice to meet you

Part engineer, part problem solver, and always excited to learn the next tool.

Hey, I'm Charan.

I'm a data engineer who builds the systems behind analytics and machine learning. My work sits between raw sources and the people who need answers: I design pipelines that collect data, clean it, model it and deliver it where it's needed, reliably and on time.

I started out in electronics and communication engineering, which taught me to think in signals and systems. That carried naturally into data. At Dell I built ETL pipelines and moved a large warehouse to the cloud. I then went deeper at Northeastern with a master's in Data Analytics Engineering, and today I work at Morgan Stanley on real-time trading data, lakehouse architecture and the data behind regulatory reporting.

What I enjoy most is taking something slow, fragile or manual and making it fast, tested and automatic. I care about data that people can trust, code that teammates can read, and platforms that are ready for whatever comes next, including AI.
